svg.title: SenWeave implementation and planned architecture
svg.desc: Implemented: bounded JSON and CBOR byte ingress, resolution and standalone output. A typed Node.js SDK bundles the MoonBit core, shares one implementation across ESM and CommonJS entry points, and accepts tighter per-call quotas. Strict extension admission precedes expansion; diagnostics omit application field names. Real npm and MoonBit archives are checked in independent consumers. A MoonBit Sender supplies bounded upload retries, cancellation and response correlation. MoonCoAP supplies exchanges and duplicate response replay. Deferred delivery and business identity let the host report committed, duplicate or conflicting requests. A Node.js loopback UDP host persists identity in a SQLite example sink. MQTT and registry publication remain planned.
